calls.title: TickPick + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team discussed the suitability of GrowthBook’s pricing model for TickPick, emphasizing cost efficiency with a flat fee and per-seat pricing model. The Pro plan, costing $40 per seat per month, supports up to 50 users and offers advanced features, making it ideal for TickPick’s anticipated small user base of 5 to 10 seats. The conversation highlighted TickPick’s need to scale product experimentation without incurring high costs, as their buy page could generate millions of requests monthly if not cached. GrowthBook’s integration capabilities with TickPick's existing event pipeline were noted, alongside support for sophisticated pricing tests and the flexibility of deployment options. Furthermore, advancements in feature flagging, analysis tools like Bayesian statistics, and comprehensive onboarding support were underscored as key to enabling efficient experimentation within TickPick.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flags, Cost Model, Data Warehouse Integration, Bayesian Analysis, Self-Hosting

calls.title: TickPick + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting covered multiple aspects of cost management and product features essential to Tickpick’s experimentation platform. Current annual spending is estimated between $5,000 and $6,000, with a cautionary approach to budget controls emphasized by Matt Ellis. The discussion noted the Pro plan's sufficiency for current needs but anticipated mobile growth necessitating an upgrade to the Enterprise plan, which offers increased request limits. Security measures for SDK payloads were evaluated, favoring ciphered mode for simpler A/B tests. Efforts to enhance the experimentation culture and product analytics were highlighted, with ongoing support from Christian Liebenow and Logan. Future steps include a follow-up call to discuss experimentation strategies and a commitment to develop cost governance features.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Experimentation, CDN Usage, Cost Monitoring, Product Analytics, Namespace
